description: This file implements a persistent data access layer for async search operations on 'things' stored in MongoDB. It manages index initialization, count, search with pagination, and metadata streaming, primarily for the 'thingsearch' service within the Ditto project.

classes.name: MongoThingsSearchPersistence
classes.description: Implements asynchronous MongoDB search persistence for 'things', providing index management, counting, searching with pagination, and streaming of metadata.

methods.name: initializeIndices
methods.description: Initializes database indices for the collection.

methods.name: generateNamespaceCountReport
methods.description: Generates a report aggregating counts of documents by namespace.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts documents matching the specified query and optional authorizations.

methods.name: sudoCount
methods.description: Performs an unfiltered count based on the query.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Performs a paginated search for all matching 'things' adhering to the provided query and authorization constraints.

methods.name: findAllUnlimited
methods.description: Performs an unlimited search for all matching 'things' without pagination limits.

methods.name: sudoStreamMetadata
methods.description: Streams metadata of 'things' starting from a lower bound, or all if dummy.

methods.name: MongoThingsSearchPersistence
methods.description: Constructor initializing persistence with a MongoDB client and actor system.

methods.name: withHintsByNamespace
methods.description: Creates a new instance with specific query hints per namespace.
